protocol.detection: permutation_p: fixed-arm null of the recorded configuration; p_max_configurations: joint-permutation maximum over the configurations it was selected from (detection within that set only; no correction of the selected magnitude)
protocol.numerical_tolerance: empirical and protocol-specific; not a universal error bound; does not cover seed-unstable fits
protocol.evidence_rule: resolved if estimate - 1.645 s.e. > null mean + epsilon_tol; an operational classification of evidence sufficiency, not a calibrated confidence procedure
protocol.selection: if the configuration was selected on the full cohort, the interval and usable recoverability are conditional on it

supported_interpretations: above-null recoverability under the stated representation, readout family and protocol (permutation p = 0.040; max over 4 configurations p = 0.059)
insufficient evidence under the operational resolution criterion (lower 90% bound -0.0069 < threshold 0.0014 nats)
measured incremental recoverability persists after adjustment for the evaluated covariates: 0.0106 nats
interpretations_not_established: resolution of the measurement under this protocol
absence of molecular information in the tissue, or under another representation, readout or cohort size
external generalizability to other cohorts, sites, scanners or magnifications
spatially localized molecular fidelity of tile-level evidence
causal mechanism or causal attribution of the information to tissue biology
absence of residual confounding by unmeasured biological, clinical or acquisition-related variables
independence from the foundation model's pretraining data
a lower bound on population mutual information
recoverability within any constituent subgroup of the cohort
